mn91:26.19: “Worthy Gotama, the brahmin Brahmāyu asks if you are healthy and well, nimble, strong, and living comfortably.
mn91:26.21: ‘Worthy Gotama, the brahmin Brahmāyu is old, elderly, and senior, advanced in years, having reached the final stage of life; he is a hundred and twenty years old. He has mastered the three Vedas, together with their vocabularies and ritual performance, their phonology and word classification, and the testaments as fifth. He knows them word-by-word, and their grammar. He is well versed in cosmology and the marks of a great man.
